findings.location: content.body.steps[id=s3].blocks[2].text: «А от про звичку estar + герундій не підходить.»; content.body.steps[id=s8].blocks[0].items[3]: «Про «зараз» часто підходять обидві форми; про звичку — лише простий теперішній.»
findings.description: Both passages categorically exclude habitual uses of the progressive. Spanish permits repeated or habitual situations presented as ongoing, especially temporary routines, as in «Últimamente estoy trabajando los sábados».
findings.suggestion: Explain that the simple present is the usual unmarked choice for general habits, while estar + gerundio can highlight the temporary or ongoing character of repeated activity. Remove both categorical exclusions.

items.reviewerAnswer: Estar + gerundio expresses ongoing activity. The simple present commonly expresses general habits, but the progressive can also describe temporary routines or repeated ongoing situations.
items.notes: The lesson's acknowledgment that both forms can describe current actions is correct.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, chapter 28, discussion of estar + gerundio and habitual/iterative interpretations (from memory).
Course contract, rule 8; review duties concerning false rules and misleading simplifications.

findings.location: task.prompt[1].text: «Los sábados ___ al fútbol con mis amigos.»; task.options[id=b].label: «estoy jugando» and feedbackUk: «Los sábados — регулярна дія, звичка: тут потрібен простий теперішній.»
findings.description: Los sábados establishes recurrence but does not determine the aspectual perspective. The packet does not exclude a temporary recurring arrangement or a repeated ongoing situation, under which the progressive is possible.
findings.suggestion: Specify the intended aspectual reading, or accept both forms with explanations of their readings. Do not derive a unique simple-present answer from Los sábados alone.

items.reviewerAnswer: a is the neutral general-habit answer. b can describe a current recurring arrangement or activity underway on Saturdays; both fit different readings.
items.notes: This concerns the form-choice key; the supported role permits the visible guidance.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, chapter 28, estar + gerundio with habitual/iterative interpretations (from memory).
Packet verdict definition: use uncertain when different reasonable readings are not resolved by the context.

findings.location: task.prompt[1].text: «Normalmente mi padre ___ en un banco, pero esta semana está de vacaciones.»; task.options[id=b].label: «está trabajando» and feedbackUk: «Normalmente — звичка: тут потрібен простий теперішній.»
findings.description: Normalmente can modify an ongoing situation as well as an unmarked habitual present. The holiday contrast favors trabaja but does not make está trabajando categorically unacceptable.
findings.suggestion: Clarify that the task asks for the unmarked statement of his usual employment, or allow both readings and revise the feedback.

items.reviewerAnswer: a for a general statement about his usual employment; b is possible when describing his normally ongoing activity. The intended perspective is not fully fixed.
items.notes: The simple present is the more neutral choice here; preference alone does not establish that the alternative is incorrect.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, chapter 28, habitual/iterative interpretations of estar + gerundio (from memory).
Packet verdict definition concerning underdetermined readings.

findings.location: task.prompt[1].text: «—¿Dónde está Pablo? —En el parque: …»; task.options[id=b].label: «juega con el perro los domingos.» and feedbackUk: «Los domingos — звичка, а питають, де Пабло зараз і що робить.»
findings.description: The question asks where Pablo is, and En el parque already answers it. A habitual clause can then explain that location on a Sunday. The day is unspecified, and the question does not explicitly ask what he is doing.
findings.suggestion: Ask explicitly for Pablo's activity at the moment of speaking and state that the continuation must report that activity, or allow the explanatory routine reading.

items.reviewerAnswer: a directly describes Pablo's current activity. b can explain his whereabouts through his Sunday routine if today is Sunday.
items.notes: Option a is the most immediate continuation, but the supplied context does not exclude b's explanatory function.
sources: Packet, task.prompt[1] and task.options[id=b].
Packet verdict definition concerning missing context and alternative reasonable readings.
RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, chapter 23, habitual uses of the present indicative (from memory).

findings.location: task.prompt[1].text: «En mi casa ___ a las nueve todos los días.»; task.options[id=b].label: «estamos cenando» and feedbackUk: «Todos los días — звичка: тут потрібен простий теперішній.»
findings.description: The combination of a reference time and daily recurrence permits the progressive: dinner can be underway at nine each day. The prompt does not specify whether nine is the usual meal time or a point during the meal.
findings.suggestion: Specify the intended temporal perspective, or accept both forms with feedback distinguishing the two readings.

items.reviewerAnswer: a states the usual dinner time; b says dinner is in progress at nine every day. Both readings are possible.
items.notes: Todos los días does not independently exclude a progressive construction.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, chapter 28, estar + gerundio, reference-time interpretation and repeated situations (from memory).
Packet verdict definition concerning underdetermined readings.

findings.location: task.prompt[1].text: «¡Hola, Marta! Ahora mismo ___ con mis padres. Hablamos más tarde.»; task.options[id=b].label: «ceno los sábados» and its incorrect outcome.
findings.description: Ahora mismo can refer to current circumstances over a broader period. On that reading, the speaker currently has Saturday dinners with their parents. Hablamos más tarde favors the immediate-action interpretation but does not explicitly establish it.
findings.suggestion: State that the message reports a single action underway at the instant of writing, or revise the options and feedback to accommodate the current-routine reading.

items.reviewerAnswer: a is strongly favored for an action underway while writing. b is possible if ahora mismo refers to the speaker's current routine or arrangements.
items.notes: The intended answer is clear as a preference; the uncertainty concerns categorical rejection of the broader temporal reading.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, chapter 23, present-time reference extending beyond the instant of speech (from memory).
Packet verdict definition concerning underdetermined temporal readings.
